selected_architecture.purpose: Test whether a teacher-blind explicit atomic scientific-obligation layer can close the known four-atom development residual at fixed primary evidence budget, or at minimum detect unresolved CORE obligations and fail closed to fallback.

selected_discriminating_experiment.scope: single legacy development teacher paper only; no acceptance papers

hypotheses.H1_ATOMIC_OBLIGATION_COVERAGE_GAP: The four residuals persist because automatic runtime obligations are too compound or incomplete; explicit generic lifecycle/failure obligations expose source support.
hypotheses.H2_FIXED_BUDGET_SELECTION_COLLISION: The obligations are exposable, but fixed-budget integration loses needed evidence or preservation unless selection is reallocated.
hypotheses.H3_SAFE_INCOMPLETENESS_IS_POSSIBLE: When a CORE obligation remains unsatisfied after selection, a teacher-blind completeness controller can detect that state and invoke fallback instead of claiming local completeness.
hypotheses.H4_LEGACY_ANCHOR_UNDERCOUNT: Some source-faithful repeated/paraphrastic evidence is semantically sufficient even when the legacy exact-anchor evaluator marks the atom unsupported.

runtime_obligations.generic_information_need: During supervised classifier training, what labels are used and what data/domain supplies those labels?
runtime_obligations.bm25_query: classifier training labels data domain source

runtime_obligations.generic_information_need: During testing or evaluation, what data/domain is the trained classifier applied to?
runtime_obligations.bm25_query: classifier testing evaluation data domain target

runtime_obligations.generic_information_need: What receiver or acquisition hardware captures the observations, and what sampling configuration or rate is used?
runtime_obligations.bm25_query: receiver acquisition hardware sampling rate samples
runtime_obligations.coupling_rule: Prefer one proposition witnessing both hardware and sampling groups; otherwise the obligation remains incomplete in the primary one-proposition reservation.

runtime_obligations.generic_information_need: What persistent or repeated failure mode is observed, and what investigation or follow-up do the authors identify?
runtime_obligations.bm25_query: persistent consistent misclassification failure investigation further future
runtime_obligations.coupling_rule: Prefer one proposition witnessing both persistent failure and follow-up groups; otherwise the obligation remains incomplete in the primary one-proposition reservation.

runtime_candidate_generation.corpus: exact frozen proposition corpus for arxiv:2403.04036 from the already-reviewed development substrate
runtime_candidate_generation.eligibility: Candidate must satisfy at least one token from every frozen witness group for its obligation after lowercase ASCII normalization; no teacher atom, expected page, removed proposition, or source-fidelity equivalence set is visible here.

primary_budget28_selection.starting_set: exact 28-proposition LOCAL_RESCUE_CONFIRMED selected set from run 40143476764
operation: Mark any obligation already witnessed by the frozen starting set as satisfied.
For each still-missing obligation in frozen order, choose its highest-ranked eligible BM25 witness not already selected.
If an addition is needed, evict exactly one unprotected selected proposition using the frozen structural-dispensability order.
Never exceed 28 selected propositions and never add more than one proposition for one obligation.
structural_dispensability_order: fewest appearances across frozen pre-existing automatic intent top-12 rankings
worst best rank across those rankings

append_only_budget32_sensitivity.purpose: Cause discrimination only; not a promotion candidate and not permission to increase the final architecture budget.
append_only_budget32_sensitivity.operation: Append the same highest-ranked missing-obligation witnesses without eviction up to four propositions, maximum selected count 32.
append_only_budget32_sensitivity.interpretation: If budget32 closes a residual that budget28 cannot, classify a fixed-budget selection collision rather than an exposure failure.

completeness_controller.complete_iff: Every frozen CORE runtime obligation has at least one selected eligible witness under its runtime witness groups.
completeness_controller.false_complete_definition: Controller returns complete while posthoc source-fidelity evaluation shows one or more of the four mapped CORE residual facts absent.

posthoc_evaluation_only.prior_supported_atoms_must_be_retained: all 9 atoms supported by the frozen LOCAL_RESCUE_CONFIRMED baseline, including all 7 frozen controls plus e1.a and e6.a

metrics: runtime CORE obligation witnesses satisfied out of 4
posthoc source-fidelity residual support out of 4
legacy exact-anchor residual support out of 4
prior supported atom retention out of 9
number and identities of deterministic swaps
budget32 append-only source-fidelity residual support out of 4
legacy-anchor undercount atoms and supporting proposition IDs

secondary_evaluator_outcome.LEGACY_ANCHOR_UNDERCOUNT_CONFIRMED: Source-fidelity support exceeds legacy exact-anchor support for at least one residual via only the predeclared equivalence sets.
secondary_evaluator_outcome.NO_LEGACY_ANCHOR_UNDERCOUNT_OBSERVED: Source-fidelity and legacy exact-anchor support counts are identical.

selected_discriminating_experiment.stopping_rule: Exactly one valid frozen diagnostic run. Stop on the first valid outcome; no post-result query, witness-group, obligation-order, eviction-order, budget, equivalence-set, or threshold tuning and no valid-result rerun.

mechanism_outcome_partition.INVALID_EXECUTION: Any frozen input identity, budget, ordering, teacher-blind boundary, or source-fidelity separation gate fails.
mechanism_outcome_partition.PRESERVATION_REGRESSION: Primary budget28 loses any frozen control or any atom from the prior 9/9 supported set.
mechanism_outcome_partition.ATOMIC_RESIDUAL_CLOSURE_CONFIRMED: Primary budget28 retains prior 9/9 and 7/7 controls and source-fidelity supports all four residual atoms.
mechanism_outcome_partition.BUDGET_SELECTION_COLLISION: All four residuals are source-fidelity supported by append-only budget32, primary budget28 misses at least one, and no preservation regression occurred.
mechanism_outcome_partition.OBLIGATION_EXPOSURE_GAP: At least one residual cannot be source-fidelity supported even by the frozen top-12 obligation candidates / append-only budget32 sensitivity.

completeness_safety_outcome_partition.INVALID_EXECUTION: Any teacher-blind completeness boundary or frozen controller rule fails.
completeness_safety_outcome_partition.COMPLETE_WITH_CLOSURE: All four runtime CORE obligations have selected eligible witnesses and posthoc source-fidelity supports all four residuals.
completeness_safety_outcome_partition.SAFE_INCOMPLETENESS_CONFIRMED: At least one CORE obligation is unsatisfied or at least one source-fidelity residual remains absent, and the controller returns LOCAL_INCOMPLETE_REQUIRE_FALLBACK.
completeness_safety_outcome_partition.UNSAFE_FALSE_COMPLETE: At least one source-fidelity residual remains absent but the controller returns complete.

acceptance_boundary_evidence.RESIDUAL_CLOSURE: Mechanism outcome is ATOMIC_RESIDUAL_CLOSURE_CONFIRMED, completeness outcome is COMPLETE_WITH_CLOSURE, and no preservation regression exists.
acceptance_boundary_evidence.SAFE_INCOMPLETENESS: Completeness outcome is SAFE_INCOMPLETENESS_CONFIRMED with prior controls retained; mechanism root cause may independently be BUDGET_SELECTION_COLLISION or OBLIGATION_EXPOSURE_GAP.
acceptance_boundary_evidence.NONE: Any invalid execution, preservation regression, unsafe false-complete, or other combination.

selected_discriminating_experiment.reporting_rule: Always report mechanism_outcome and completeness_safety_outcome independently before deriving acceptance_boundary_evidence. Root-cause classification must never suppress or overwrite safe-incompleteness evidence.

interpretation_authority.on_ATOMIC_RESIDUAL_CLOSURE_CONFIRMED: Supports integrating this bounded atomic-obligation coverage mechanism into a later end-to-end development candidate. Does not by itself justify acceptance freeze or production promotion.
interpretation_authority.on_SAFE_INCOMPLETENESS_CONFIRMED: Supports the safe-incompleteness branch of the pre-acceptance rule independently of whether the unresolved root cause is budget selection or obligation exposure; analogous missing CORE obligations force fallback rather than false local completion. Broader development validation is still required before acceptance freeze.
interpretation_authority.on_BUDGET_SELECTION_COLLISION: Residual evidence is exposable but fixed-budget selection remains the mechanism bottleneck; next design may alter selection/allocation, not retriever/model family.
interpretation_authority.on_OBLIGATION_EXPOSURE_GAP: The explicit obligation schema or witness logic is insufficient; revise obligation discovery/recognition rather than scaling rankers merely because 13/13 was not reached.
interpretation_authority.on_PRESERVATION_REGRESSION: Reject the proposed residual-closure selector as unsafe for existing supported evidence.
interpretation_authority.on_UNSAFE_FALSE_COMPLETE: Reject the completeness controller; acceptance freeze is blocked.
